text:
rachel-finance: OrbitScale (enterprise) opened a billing dispute for May. They claim bulk load tests were mis-tagged and want a refund + relaxed payment terms. Proposal: one-time credit $27,500 + defer next 2 invoices to Net60 (temporary). Need deal-desk approval + legal amendment.

kevin-sales: Sales supports. OrbitScale is in advanced talks for a multi-region expansion. They asked for flexibility to avoid pausing traffic. We verbally promised payment flexibility during contract talks.

amal-salesops: Recon numbers: billed tokens 980k vs committed 650k. Overage calc = $29,200. Sales allowance ~ $6k should have applied but didn't. Proposed shared credit $27,500. Sheet (r/o): https://sheets.internal/redwood/orbitscale-may-recon-1901

billing-bot: Invoice snapshot:
```
Invoice: INV-2026-05-28
Total: $61,800
Lines: Base COMM-650K: $39,600; Overage: $22,200
```

rachel-finance: Notes: (1) mis-tagged bulk loads due to missing test flag in SDK; ops patched. (2) Credit reduces revenue for the period; AR must confirm credit & deferred terms treatment. (3) We must include explicit non-precedent language in amendment.

gina-cfo: I can approve one-time credits up to $35k with legal sign-off and AR sign-off on deferred terms. @mark-legal please draft amendment that ties the credit to an agreement to Net60 for two invoices and a clause that this is non-precedential.

mark-legal: Will draft. Suggested language: "This one-time reconciliation credit and temporary payment-term amendment (Net60 for next two invoices) is granted solely to resolve the referenced billing dispute and shall not modify Redwood's standard pricing or payment policies or create precedent." Will route via DocuSign. Any additional covenants?

kevin-sales: Customer will sign quickly; they prefer the amendment to be concise and computable. I'll get OrbitScale's procurement included.

paula-ar: AR can post credit memo and log Net60 schedule after signed amendment. GL for credit: 4102 Customer Credits. JE template suggested:
```
DR Customer Credits (4102) $27,500
CR Revenue (4001) $27,500
Memo: OrbitScale May recon credit - deal desk; attach amendment DSGN-xxxx
```

amal-salesops: I'll create concession code DEALDESK-ORBIT-1901 and update CRM owner for renewal. Also flag other SDK v1.4 customers for audit.

gina-cfo: Approved $27,500 one-time credit and Net60 for next two invoices contingent on signed amendment and AR procedures. Document decision in DEAL_DESK ledger.

mark-legal: Drafted amendment and uploaded: https://legal.internal/redwood/amendments/orbitscale-credit-net60-v1.pdf. Included non-precedent clause and an acknowledgment that the credit resolves disputes through the invoice date. DocuSign envelope: DSGN-123777. Status: sent.

billing-bot: DocuSign status: sent. Invoice INV-2026-05-28 flagged PENDING-CREDIT+NET60.

paula-ar: Once signed I'll post Credit Memo CM-2026-05-ORBIT and set payment terms for next two invoices to Net60 in billing config. Will confirm tax treatment before posting.

rachel-finance: Thanks team. Kevin, please own customer comms and send signed amendment copy to AR. Closing thread when credit posted and billing terms updated. :white_check_mark:
